summary: Register YandexGPT as a fourth ai-family provider for the Task-122 AI provider account capability, using folder-scoped model URIs and a boundary-only Health that cannot carry the tenant FolderID.

impacts.evidence: YandexGPT reuses the Task-122 ai_provider_accounts table (including its folder_id column) and secret binding; it adds no tenant persistence of its own.
The only tenant text that leaves TORGNEXA through this provider is the caller-assembled analytics prompt at analyze-call time; FolderID is non-secret tenant configuration, not credential material.
YandexGPT is reached through the existing Task-122 /settings/ai-providers:analyze operation; no new public operation is added.
No EventBus schema is published or consumed.

Adds the yandexgpt provider under the existing ai family/ai.completion.generate capability; dispatch by provider id is confined to internal/platform/builtinruntime. Health satisfies the frozen sdk.Connector boundary (no FolderID) and reports account/manifest validity only; the live folder-scoped probe (HealthCheckWithFolder) is reachable only through builtinruntime.
No schema change; folder_id already exists on ai_provider_accounts from Task-122.

Provider code has no direct network authority; the completion call is host-mediated through builtinruntime's DNS-pinned, public-IP-only transport. Credential bytes are read only inside a host-owned UseSecret callback.
Reuses the Task-122 ai.analyze / settings.ai_providers.* capability gates unchanged.
Reuses the Task-122 audit entries unchanged.
This capability performs no remote-state synchronization.
Outbound calls use a host-injected transport to a fixed host (llm.api.cloud.yandex.net); no inbound webhook surface is added.
Remote non-2xx responses and empty/malformed completions normalize to a bounded error; the manifest's rate_limit/retry policy bounds concurrency and backoff.
Disabling the account row immediately stops further YandexGPT analyze calls; no other component depends on this provider.

Package tests cover the missing-FolderID rejection and gpt://<folder_id>/<model> URI construction; the canonical Task-064 conformance suite passes all thirteen checks (docs/connectors/yandexgpt/conformance-report.json), including sandbox_isolation verified under a privileged Linux runner.
